obligations.note: The change replaces self._audit(actor, "amend_memo", ...) in LedgerService.amend_memo with an application log line, so a state-changing operation (store.set_payment_memo) no longer records an audit event with actor, action, target and time. The sampled AUD-1 control test (create/approve/release only) can't detect this, and no exception covers AUD-1 for payments.service.

The only new log call site is self._log.info("payment memo updated", payment_id=payment_id). payment_id isn't in npi.NPI_FIELDS, and AppLog masks NPI keys in any case. The LOG-1 control test passes in the head-commit CI run.

Ticket CHG-24351 is approved by change manager erik.brandt on 2026-10-10, before the 2026-10-13 review. Its components [payments.service] cover the only touched path, apps/baseline-payments/payments/service.py.
The code_review approval is from mara.costa, a payments change_approver and a different person from the author aisha.bello (none of her addresses).
The approval names the head commit 8311056, and there are no later commits.

records/ci/run.json shows pr-checks succeeding on head 8311056. The JUnit report has 172 tests with 0 failures or skips, including the AUD-1 and LOG-1 control tests. The report's timestamp (2026-10-23, a developer laptop host) doesn't match the recorded run, and I couldn't re-run locally because pytest is missing.
The only touched component, payments.service, is not marked security_sensitive, so no security_review is required.
No protected paths (controls/, control tests, ci/) are changed, so no control_owner approval is required.
The change is not an emergency (emergency=false, ticket type standard), so no post-implementation review is due.
The change relies on no exception. The register has no AUD-1 exception for payments.service, so nothing excuses the AUD-1 deviation.
No acceptance-ledger entry covers service.py (they cover payments.py, audit.py, routes.py and Java files), so no prior evidence lapses.

summary: The change removes the audit event from LedgerService.amend_memo and replaces it with an application log line, so a state-changing operation is no longer audited. That violates AUD-1, and no approved exception covers it. CI passes only because the AUD-1 control test samples create, approve and release and never calls amend_memo. The ticket, independent review, approval coverage and recorded CI run all hold, but one refuted critical obligation means the change must be rejected.
